title: SellerClaw edge agent manifest (POST /manifest body)
description: Wire format aligned with sellerclaw-agent SaveManifestRequest / BundleManifest.to_save_manifest_mapping(). OpenClaw LiteLLM model metadata is generated in-code, not from this payload.

agent_api_base_path.description: Path segment appended to `SELLERCLAW_API_URL` to form the agent API base URL (e.g. `/agent`). The agent derives `SELLERCLAW_AGENT_API_BASE_URL = SELLERCLAW_API_URL + agent_api_base_path` and uses it both as the `{{api_base_url}}` prompt template variable and as the `baseUrl` for the `sellerclaw-web-search` OpenClaw plugin.

template_variables.description: Wire-level prompt template variables. The `api_base_url` variable is **not** shipped here — the agent injects it automatically from `SELLERCLAW_API_URL + agent_api_base_path`.

web_search.description: Only `enabled` is honored; extra keys (legacy provider/api_key) are ignored by the agent but may appear during monolith migration.

image_model.description: Image generation model surfaced through OpenClaw's `agents.defaults.imageGenerationModel.primary`. The agent emits a matching entry under `models.providers.litellm.models` so OpenClaw can resolve the reference; LiteLLM provider routing for the alias is configured operator-side. Consumed by OpenClaw's built-in `image_generate` tool.

model_id.description: Stable catalog id from the monolith registry (e.g. `gpt-image-2`).

openclaw_alias.description: Suffix appended to `model_name_prefix` to build the OpenClaw model group id.

litellm_route.description: LiteLLM model route used operator-side to wire the alias to the real provider (e.g. `openai/gpt-image-1`). Carried for diagnostics; the edge agent does not call providers directly.

video_model.description: Video generation model surfaced through OpenClaw's `agents.defaults.videoGenerationModel.primary`. Consumed by OpenClaw's built-in `video_generate` tool; the agent emits a matching entry under `models.providers.litellm.models`.
